briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and news outlets, including NDTV, Hindustan Times, The Quint, and FACTLY, have debunked claims that Prime Minister Modi or the BJP are offering free mobile recharge for three months. These claims, often circulating on social media, have been identified as hoaxes or scams designed to collect user data or spread misinformation. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) has also clarified that no such scheme is being run by the government. Some reports, such as one from Akashvani News on 2026-08-18, indicate that videos promoting these claims are AI-generated.
